data.name: Japha
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew language, Japha means 'God is Healing'. In the Bible, Japha is the name of a son born to Athaliah, the wicked queen of Judah, who was killed during the reign of Josiah. The name symbolizes the hope and healing that can come even in the midst of darkness and adversity.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God's healing power and the hope that can be found in His love.
data.numerology_meaning: Japha is a determined and hardworking individual who values tradition and stability. They have a strong sense of purpose and are often natural leaders.
